## Checklist

- [ ] Branch from `dev`, PR to `dev` / Branch a partir da `dev`, PR pra `dev`
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run build` pass / passam
- [ ] `cargo check` and `cargo test` pass with no warnings / passam sem warnings
- [ ] Tested in the installed app (`scripts/install-local.sh`) / Testado no app instalado
- [ ] New logic has tests / Lógica nova tem teste
- [ ] Screenshots or GIF for visual changes / Prints ou GIF em mudança visual
